cta_buttons.label: Pre-order now
cta_buttons.behavior: The only primary CTA in the buy box on BOTH ASINs (PS5 and Xbox), verified on two passes (guest with an empty cart, then guest with this item already in the cart). It is Amazon's Buy Now control: input#buy-now-button (type=submit, title 'Buy Now', aria-labelledby submit.buy-now-announce whose text is 'Pre-order now') inside span#submit.buy-now (orange rgb(255,164,28), 206x32px, 100px radius) inside form#addToCart (POST /gp/product/handle-buy-box/ref=dp_start-bbf_1_glance). DOM inspection: #add-to-cart-button, submit.add-to-cart and submit.add-to-cart-announce are ABSENT from the page (not merely hidden), so there is no add-to-cart path from the buy box at all. Clicking goes to /checkout/entry/buynow?...isBuyNow=1&ASIN=B0H6K928WL and, for a signed-out shopper, straight to the sign-in wall /ap/signin (assoc_handle=amazon_checkout_us). Whether a signed-in shopper sees an extra yellow 'Add to Cart' could not be verified (no sign-in allowed); because the buy box is rendered per offer rather than per account, the same single-button box is the expected signed-in view (confidence medium).

add_to_cart.contents: Verified live (desktop, guest, 1024px viewport). Product page: there is no add-to-cart step at all — 'Pre-order now' is Buy Now and jumps straight to checkout entry (sign-in wall for guests). Search tile 'Add to cart': the page does not navigate and no 'Added to cart' page, side sheet or toast rendered. Instead (a) the header cart badge flips from '0' to '1' (aria '1 item in cart'), (b) the tile shows '1 in cart', and (c) the fixed right-rail cart panel (div#nav-flyout-ewc, Amazon's 'everywhere cart': white, 1px #BBBBBB left border, ~100px wide, full viewport height, present but empty before the add) fills in with: '1 item' · heading 'Subtotal' · '$79.99' · 'Your order qualifies for FREE delivery.' / 'Choose this option at checkout.' · white outline pill 'Go to Cart' (1px #888C8C border, 100px radius, ~91px wide, → /cart?ref_=ox_ewc_ret_gtc_dsk_us) · item list: thumbnail (link /gp/product/B0H6K928WL/ref=ewc_pr_img_1?smid=ATVPDKIKX0DER&psc=1), '$79.99', truncated title link 'Grand Theft Auto VI - PlayStation 5 (Code in Box, ...', quantity stepper (left half-pill trash 'Delete …' button, number input 'Qty:', right half-pill '+' 'Increase quantity by one'), 'Update' link. Hidden status strings in the panel: 'was removed from Shopping Cart.', 'was already removed from Shopping Cart.', 'Moved to' / 'Saved For Later', 'Delete Failed. Try again', 'Update failed. Try again', 'We couldn't save this item for later, try again', 'Updating quantity'. The DOM also contains an empty 'ewc-smart-wagon-desktop-sideSheet' container (Amazon's side-sheet shell), which did not open in this session — so on narrower desktops Amazon may instead show an 'Added to cart' side sheet; not observed here. The first click did not register until the button was scrolled into view.
